about: Synthetic: a red position whose thesis still holds must not be sold.

position.thesis: Pullback to the 50-day average in an uptrend carried by rising industrial orders; the dip came on light volume.
position.invalidation: A close below atr_stop_2x, or a sign that order growth is reversing.

headlines.text:
<untrusted source="Reuters">
Industrial stocks slip as euro strengthens. European machinery shares fell with the sector; analysts at a large bank reiterated their buy rating on Halvorsen, citing a full order book.
